title.zh: 日本三大行联合完成日元稳定币共同发行与跨境支付实证
title.en: 日本三大行联合完成日元稳定币共同发行与跨境支付实证

current_state.zh: Mizuho, MUFG, SMBC, MUFG Trust and TISI announced they completed an FSA-backed pilot for jointly issuing a yen stablecoin under Japan's Funds Settlement Act and using it for cross-border settlement, validating the full issuance, transfer and redemption flow ahead of planned FY2026 live transactions.
current_state.en: Mizuho, MUFG, SMBC, MUFG Trust and TISI announced they completed an FSA-backed pilot for jointly issuing a yen stablecoin under Japan's Funds Settlement Act and using it for cross-border settlement, validating the full issuance, transfer and redemption flow ahead of planned FY2026 live transactions.
